thread:
anna: Kicked off cross-region long-seq (1k) and iso-SLA bs=1 runs for Mistral/LLAMA2/Mosaic on A100 vs H100. Focus: prefill+decode tail, kernel selection, and $/1M tokens for q8x4 vs q4_0.

mike: run matrix?

anna: short:
- models: mistral-7b, llama2-7b-chat, mosaic-7b
- quants: q8x4, q4_0
- seq: prefill 512/1024, decode 512/1024
- batch: bs=1 (iso), bs=4 for throughput
- regions: us-west1, eu-west1, asia-east1
- KV: cold vs warm

zach: early dashboard numbers (warm KV, q8x4, bs=1):
- H100 tokens/sec (decode-only): 3300 tok/s
- A100 tokens/sec: 2550 tok/s
- prefill p50: H100 45ms, A100 62ms
- p95 end-to-end short seq: H100 145ms, A100 260ms
- p99 long seq (cold KV): H100 ~390ms, A100 ~820ms
- $/1M tokens (decode-only, NA with reserved): H100 $2.95, A100 $2.55

eva: surprising the $ delta. did thermal profiles differ by region?

anna: yes. europe H100 nodes on one SKU warmed during sustained 1k runs and briefly switched to a fallback matmul kernel for some microbursts -> p95 spike. Asia stable with different SKU.

perf-bot: trace snippet uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/longseq/4310001122/trace.log

mike: what kernel fallbacks looked like?

anna: sample trace:
```
[KERNEL_SELECT] flash_attn_v2 -> fast_flash (H100)
[KERNEL_FALLBACK] flash_attn_v2 -> fallback_matmul (when seq>900 or temp>75C)
[KV] hit_rate=0.88 warm, cold_hit=0.03
```

zach: observed that fallback_matmul latencies are ~3-5x per-step vs fast_flash, so even short windows blow p95.

sam: ops guidance for sizing?

anna: use steady tokens/sec with 20% headroom for autoscaling. Example: H100 steady decode 3300 -> target 2640 tok/s per GPU. For a workload needing 100k tok/s steady -> ceil(100k/2640)=38 GPUs.

sam: burst policy?

anna: recommend 2.5x burst capacity with short-lived spare pool and queue-depth triggers. Prefer H100 for strict p99 SLOs; A100 is cost-effective if steady-state decode heavy and p99 less strict.

mike: quality impact q4_0 vs q8x4?

anna: small but measurable. Llama2 chat eval on 2k sample set: q4_0 had 1.2% drop vs q8x4 on macro metrics. Mistral drop ~0.5%. Flagging q4_0 for canary only.

eva: reproduce command?

anna: 
```
bench run --model {mistral-7b,llama2-7b-chat,mosaic-7b} --quant {q8x4,q4_0} \
  --gpu {a100,h100} --batch 1 --prefill 1024 --decode 512 --region {us-west1,eu-west1,asia-east1} \
  --trace kernels --kv warm_cold
```

zach: followups: collect per-kernel histograms and thermal telemetry. If fallback_matmul correlates with temp spikes, add thermal-aware routing.

perf-bot: summary: H100 wins latency and tail; A100 cheaper per-token in NA under reserved pricing for q8x4. q4_0 shows small quality regressions; require AB eval before rollout.

anna: created infra ticket INF-6402 to add thermal metrics to perf dashboards and an action to run 48h mixed qps test across regions. cc @sam @zach @eva

sam: :thumbsup:

zach: noted and assigned.
